statement: Conditional on MOP16-14-v1 passing its global dinucleotide-null gate, the fixed A2451-centered 23S window (positions 2426-2476) will contain at least one masked token shared with both original PYRO and YEAST genomes, and the real target-shared-token count will exceed every matched dinucleotide-null target count.
test: Use the fixed target test exactly as defined in 21_MASKED_OPCODE_PREREG_v1.md after global counts are frozen. Do not alter mask family, window, orientation, span, or weight.
support_condition: Global MOP gate PASS AND real_target_count > max(five null target counts) AND real_target_count > 0.
weakening_condition: Global gate passes but target count is nonzero without exceeding every null target count.
falsification_condition: Global gate passes and real target count is zero, or is no greater than the null target distribution.
contamination_boundary: Frozen before any MOP16-14 token is generated from biological input or the target window is inspected under this representation.
